caption: The drawing is rendered in shades of gray on a cream background and depicts a large, ornate teapot with a rounded body, a wide spout on the left, and a large, curved handle on the right featuring scrollwork at both ends. The teapot has a domed lid with a slightly raised center. The composition centers the teapot, framed by a thin, rectangular border. In the upper left corner, there is a decorative monogram consisting of the intertwined letters "GHS." In the upper right corner, there is a rectangular label containing the name "Anna Bleecker" and the date "Feb 22nd 1850." In the lower left corner, there is a small square showing a side view of what appears to be a ruffled bowl or footed dish, and in the lower right corner, there is another small square containing a simple outline sketch of the same teapot shown in the center, viewed from the same angle. The drawing is signed "Hester Duarts" at the bottom right margin below the main teapot image.
title: Silver Tankard
